rows.p: Together they took {pm_flows} of the year's flows at the highest fee rates on the platform. Both now have dedicated origination teams in three regions.
Equities saw a small outflow, offset by fixed income mandates from two pension clients. Costs per dollar managed fell again as the shared trading platform scaled.
